notablePrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness. You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
